51 Forfeiture of seized items by court on application

(1) A relevant enforcement officer may apply to the appropriate court for the forfeiture
of an item retained under section 49.

(2) Where an application for the forfeiture of an item is made under this section, the item
is to be retained while proceedings on the application are in progress.

(3) If the court is satisfied that—
(a) the item is a psychoactive substance which, if it had not been seized, was
likely to be consumed by an individual for its psychoactive effects, and
